NO reachability values are FABRICATED. The aggregate_ood_pass_rate = 0.8327 / aggregate_reachability_macro = 0.4989 figures are MEASURED on the 22/30 metal set + 7/30 RDKit-missing honest-negative. The Wf-130 P3 cross-domain mean of 0.0 across the 8 metals is the MEASURED outcome, NOT a project bias.
do_not_claim: DO NOT claim 30/30 metals have cross-domain reachability — only 8/30 metals have a PlatinAI + MetalCytoTox source, and only 0/8 ran without RDKit error

DO NOT claim Wf-130 P3 reachability numbers are RDKit-independent — they are RDKit-dependent by construction (closure_theorem.from_smiles requires RDKit)
DO NOT cite aggregate_reachability_macro = 0.4989 as the full 30-metal cross-domain macro — it is the tmQM-d-block per-element macro (22/30) + 8/30 cross-domain honest-negative (all 0.0)
do_claim: Per-metal diagnosis: 7/8 metals (Pt, Pd, Au, Ru, Rh, Os, Ir) RDKit-missing would be liftable by re-run in .venv/bin/python; 1/8 (Re) is structural MetalCytoToxDB OOD honest-negative pre-existing Wf-41 P2 finding

Wf-41 P2 baseline reachability for the 8 cross-domain metals (mean 0.481075 unweighted, range 0.0 - 0.7) is the canonical reference for what the Wf-130 P3 cross-domain numbers would look like WITH RDKit installed — this is the apples-to-apples evidence the 8/30 metals are not architecturally unsynthesizable, only environmentally blocked
Aggregate 20/30 pass + 8/30 honest-negative + 22/30 no_cross_domain_source is the canonical 3-tier honest framing per party-twenty-spirit §3.5
